capabilities: Tag a note by linking tag notes from a keywords property
Declare tag parents in a broader property, several allowed
Browse a tag tree with direct and descendant counts
Convert existing #tags into tag notes after a preview
List notes tagged with a tag or anything under it
extras: Documentation is an interactive demo vault shipped with each release and openable from a command; the plugin publishes a read-only API for other plugins and scripts; beta versions install via BRAT.
intentEvidence: a sidebar view like the core Tags pane, with both counts
problem: #tags are bare strings that cannot hold descriptions, aliases or properties, and renaming one is a vault-wide search-and-replace.

relations.evidence: per-level collapse and expand are adapted from the Tags-pane menu of Tag Wrangler
drag and drop from Link Structure (MIT)
The menu item is adapted from the Promote action of Unified Tag Links (MIT)
The check is adapted from the dictionary check of Tag Ontology (MIT)

summary: Turns tags into notes: notes are tagged by linking tag notes, with a broader-link hierarchy, a tag tree with counts, subtree queries and #tag conversion.
